title: An Exploratory Study of the Impact of COVID-19 Pandemic Disruptions on Veterinary Medical Education
reason: Quasi-experimental ANOVA comparing pre-, during- and post-COVID cohorts on standardised exams (VEA, NAVLE), OSCEs and satisfaction surveys; Canvas is mentioned only as a delivery tool and no per-student platform measure is analysed.

extraction.population: veterinary medicine students (several cohorts), US college of veterinary medicine
extraction.outcome_or_construct: VEA, NAVLE, OSCE scores; exit/alumni/employer survey satisfaction
